purpose: Japanese collectible-anime house-style calibration D1/D2/D3: same 6 canonical interests as the A/B/C round x 3 isolated anime-intensity global-style-block candidates = 18 images. Semantic hobby content must be byte-identical across D1/D2/D3 for the same hobby; only the top-level global_style prompt block differs. Test-only override, does not touch production global_style_v1.json.

expected.note: Input text token charges are additional but small relative to image output cost.

decision_gate.diagnostic: Which D1/D2/D3 anime/lifestyle balance best achieves joyful Japanese commercial-anime collectible energy while preserving semantic precision, without drifting into Western editorial/concept-art, fantasy, or childish/chibi territory? Score per the extended 11-dimension rubric (semantic PASS/MINOR/FAIL, Japanese anime feel, joy/emotional energy, collectible appeal, Zync distinctiveness, photographicness, Western editorial drift, fantasy drift, border/chrome defect, maturity/premium, scalability).
decision_gate.fallback: If none of D1/D2/D3 genuinely achieves the intended Japanese collectible feeling, do not force a winner. Recommend gemini-3.1-flash-image with style-reference image(s) as the next experiment, but do not run it automatically.
